status: parameter-choice sensitivity; source-run pin verified; comparator not an accepted replacement
finding: The statewide experiment intentionally fixed anaerobicTransExp at 99.98298 and removed anaerobic_trans_exp from the PFT samples so the default value would remain. The source-run value is a documented modeling choice, not a fitted value or an accidental woodCN substitution.

source_run_parameter_choice.classification: fixed by experiment configuration; not fitted

archived_pft_bundle.documented_decision: anaerobicTransExp was fixed at 99.98298 as a common soil value so methane would be controlled by water content rather than a per-soil exponent.
archived_pft_bundle.generated_run_check: The other five inspected soil_rice anaerobic, methane, and drainage parameters equal their posterior medians; anaerobicTransExp equals the fixed default.

generation_contract.behavior: The configuration writes 99.98298 into sipnet.default.param and the runner drops every fixed_params trait, including anaerobic_trans_exp, from the median PFT samples before PEcAn writes each run.
generation_contract.temporal_limitation: The recovered commits were recorded on 2026-09-18, after the archived 2026-09-17 configuration log. Their content matches the archived bundle, settings, and generated parameter files but does not independently identify the exact uncommitted working-tree revision used at execution.

comparator.derivation: Median of the archived soil_rice lognormal anaerobic_trans_exp distribution with meanlog 2.3 and sdlog 0.5.
comparator.interpretation: Sensitivity comparator from the archived soil_rice posterior; it was intentionally excluded from the statewide source run and is not a calibrated, validated, or accepted replacement.

current_adapter_context.observed_mapping: c2n_wood maps to woodCN and anaerobic_trans_exp maps to anaerobicTransExp
current_adapter_context.limitation: The package installation used on 2026-09-17 was later replaced and its exact build metadata are not preserved in the run log; this does not change the explicit fixed-parameter contract.

execution.unchanged_experiment: Same weather, initial states, segmentation, forced water trajectory, operations, and methane-response calculations as the frozen forced-drydown diagnostic.

interpretation: The fixed source-run exponent increases dry-period suppression relative to the soil_rice posterior-median comparator. Both cases leave the seasonal response far below the external field comparator. The provenance is sufficiently resolved to classify 99.98298 as an explicit fixed choice; its scientific suitability remains unverified.
